messages.subject: scale reliability under IRT paradigm
parts:
Hi phil

I recently found some papers that used cronbach's alpha to assess the scale reliability under the IRT paradigm, is it acceptable to adopt such approach? is there any contradiction with the local independence hypothesis as cronbach alpha increase with the inter-item correlations?

Thank you fo your precious help.

Makram

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: scale reliability under IRT paradigm
parts:
The approach is fine if the purpose is to present a marginal reliability estimate as an average across the whole test. IRT recognizes that some areas are measured better than others by tests, and therefore that information gets included in the conditional reliability estimates given the latent trait (e.g. plot(mod, type = 'rxx')). So it really depends what the presenter wants to convey. But of course, alpha only works when items are strictly ordinal.

Phil
